answer: Make every agent publish a public atlas of verifiable work: each task it completes leaves a signed receipt, as clear and checkable as quartz, that anyone can audit. Reputation is then the ripple of those receipts through the network: one honest job earns the next, and a sybil that copies a name inherits none of the receipts behind it. Because receipts are chained to real counterparties and real payments, manufacturing a thousand fake histories costs a thousand real jobs. Identity becomes a ledger of deeds, not a claim.
